authorization: User approved network candidate + original-image boundary + geometry + causal parameter tracking comparison; previous two-member cost experiment deferred, not executed
model: Two robust straight shaft boundaries with positive smoothly varying width and an image-supported half-ellipse terminal cap. Not a physical3D cone; line intersection is never a tip. Entrance refers to estimated FOV boundary, not a fixed left edge

tracking.invalid_measurement_policy: Predict geometry at most3frames with increasing age; return raw current-frame visible mask, never rasterize a history-only hypothesis as visible fiber; then clear state
tracking.reset: Each video starts empty; never carry state between images/cases. Current and past frames only, no future smoothing

fusion: For accepted current-frame geometry, keep template-supported fiber pixels only where current A0 p(fiber)>=0.35 or raw A0 fiber is present. Else retain raw fiber. Recombine each output with unchanged old190 stone, fiber priority. Count removed/added fiber and overwritten/restored stone. A geometric hypothesis is exported separately; no amodal filled mask
data: Frozen29 reviewed native400 video frames,132 image-dev with25 old190-exposed and107 unmatched groups; sequential full2694 validation-video frames for causal replay. No ordered image tracking
evaluation: Raw/geometry/causal native video metrics; raw/geometry image132 and exposure cohorts. Same frozen stone/fiber/negative gates, per-class boundaries and3small-stone frames. Report validity/rejection reasons, additions/removals and reference conflicts, conditional and all-frame results; fallback counted, no filtering out failed fits
timing: Same-frame shared all3network PIL256 FP32 core and native masks/probability CPU transfer; separately measure FOV+fit, static raster/fusion and causal update/raster/fusion. Per-arm derived cost sums measured per-frame core+required stages, not sums of percentiles. Actual total replay includes all branches, diagnostics and exports; neither is live display or isolated fresh-process latency
stop_and_decision: No parameter/threshold tuning after validation or source/label/default replacement. Failed geometry kept as evidence; no automatic training/S3. No direct tip/angle/metric laser accuracy claim without dedicated reference. Never claim fallback or stable predictions prove correct geometry
constraints: Zero training; stone_new excluded from every training use; video1/2 and derivatives validation only; A0 inference only, never training initialization;521/132/144/29 splits unchanged; reserved-test pixels never read; shape hyperparameters are engineering hypotheses, not measured device calibration
